hotspot.bed.note: The label on a button over the bed the player makes up. "Bed 04" is the bed's number on its tag and is never translated.

hotspot.monitor.note: A label on a button: the monitor beside a hospital bed. Short.

hotspot.curtainWest.note: A label on a button: the heavy curtain on the ward's west side. Short.

hotspot.curtainEast.note: A label on a button: the curtain that screens a bed for privacy. Short.

hotspot.nightstand.note: A label on a button: the small cabinet beside a bed. Short.

hotspot.record.note: A label on a button: a patient's paper chart. Short.

hotspot.sink.note: A label on a button: the ward's hand-washing sink. Short.

hotspot.trolley.note: A label on a button: a wheeled trolley holding folded linen. Short.

hotspot.register.note: A label on a button: the night nurse's sign-on book. Short.

hotspot.cabinet.note: A label on a button: a locked wall cabinet that holds keys, opened with a four-digit code. Short.

hotspot.noticeboard.note: A label on a button: a corkboard of notices. Short.

hotspot.clock.note: A label on a button: a clock on the wall. Short.

hotspot.closetDoor.note: A label on a button: the door to the supply room in the corridor. Short.

hotspot.shelf.note: A label on a button: a shelf in the supply room. Short.

hotspot.valve.note: A label on a button: a red water valve. Short.

hotspot.fuseBox.note: A label on a button: the fuse box for the emergency power. Short.

hotspot.exit.note: A label on a button: the emergency exit door. Short.

hotspot.locker.note: A label on a button: a locker in the supply room where the player can hide. Short.

hotspot.screen.note: A label on a button: a folding screen the player can hide behind. Short.

controls.lamp.note: A label on a touch button: lights or snuffs the hand lamp the player carries. One word.

controls.skip.note: A label on a touch button: skips the cutscene on screen. One word.

card.prologue.note: The title card at the start of the game, in capitals if the language has them: the first night of the story. The colon stays.
